description: This file defines a class DecisionByMetricStage which creates an Akka Streams graph stage to make credit decisions based on the maximum timer values extracted from a list of StatusInfo objects. It is responsible for evaluating monitoring metrics and deciding whether to grant credits or reject based on threshold comparisons.

classes.name: DecisionByMetricStage
classes.description: Contains static methods to create an Akka Streams graph that performs decision logic based on status info metrics.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates an Akka Streams graph stage that processes a list of StatusInfo objects to output CreditDecisions based on timer threshold logic.

methods.name: decide
methods.description: Determines whether to approve or reject credit based on comparison of max timer nanoseconds to the threshold.

methods.name: getMaxTimerNanos
methods.description: Calculates the maximum timer nanoseconds from a list of StatusInfo objects, returning either an error (left) or the max value (right).

methods.name: getMaxTimerNanosFromStatusInfo
methods.description: Extracts the maximum timer nanoseconds from a single StatusInfo object, returning an error if the data is malformed.

methods.name: left
methods.description: Helper to create a Left value containing a CreditDecision with a rejection message.
